distance_model: Empirical discrete hypocentral-distance distribution by source from the classified 260-km catalog: sqrt(Repi^2 + h^2), with Repi by Haversine to Parque Santander.
depth_model: Each catalog event uses its own depth, clipped to 0-125 km for the Zhao depth term; depth adjustment is active for h >= 15 km.
magnitude_distribution: Truncated Gutenberg-Richter incremental rates over Mw 3.0 to the configured source Mw_max; 0.025-Mw bins.
hazard_definition: Sum over source and magnitude-bin rate mass of the mean lognormal conditional exceedance probability over empirical source distances.
exponential_fit: lambda = A*exp(-B*PGA), fitted by linear regression of ln(lambda) over 0-100 cm/s2; R2 calculated in ln(lambda) space.
note: Mw_max values and sigma are user-specified scenarios. The exponential equations are descriptive fits; design PGA is interpolated directly on the numerical total hazard curve.
